d: Long, flowing midnight-blue hair with long bangs and a single ahoge atop the head. Golden-yellow eyes with a focused, youthful expression on a youthful face. A slender build, wearing a grey sleeveless top under a short black jacket with blue glowing accents, a black mini-skirt, and black thigh-high armored boots with blue glowing lines. Holding a large, futuristic black and white scythe with a glowing blue core.
